infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This app needs access to the camera to allow users to take photos or videos for creating and submitting issue tickets. For example, users can take photos of a broken item or a problem in the office and attach it to their support ticket to provide visual context to the support team.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app needs access to the photo library to allow users to select and upload photos for creating and submitting issue tickets. For example, users can choose existing photos of a problem to attach to their support ticket to provide visual context to the support team.
